dict.string: Luoto uses Apple Music to find animated artwork for the lock screen, if you turn that on.
Luoto needs audio capture permission to show the real-time music waveform and to set the volume of individual apps. Audio is only processed live and is never recorded or saved.
Luoto finds nearby devices on your network to send files with LocalSend, if you turn that on.
Luoto takes a screenshot only when you press the snip button in the Screen Assistant.
